info.name: Add Block Storage to a Cluster

params.name: bdsInstanceId
params.description: The OCID of the cluster.

items.docs: Adds block storage to existing worker/compute only worker nodes. The same amount of storage will be added to all worker/compute only worker nodes. No change will be made to storage that is already attached. Block storage cannot be removed.

info.name: Add Cloud SQL to a Cluster

params.name: bdsInstanceId
params.description: The OCID of the cluster.

items.docs: Adds Cloud SQL to your cluster. You can use Cloud SQL to query against non-relational data stored in multiple big data sources, including Apache Hive, HDFS, Oracle NoSQL Database, and Apache HBase. Adding Cloud SQL adds a query server node to the cluster and creates cell servers on all the worker nodes in the cluster.

info.name: Add Master Nodes to a Cluster

params.name: bdsInstanceId
params.description: The OCID of the cluster.

items.docs: Increases the size (scales out) of a cluster by adding master nodes. The added master nodes will have the same shape and will have the same amount of attached block storage as other master nodes in the cluster.

info.name: Add Utility Nodes to a Cluster

params.name: bdsInstanceId
params.description: The OCID of the cluster.

items.docs: Increases the size (scales out) of a cluster by adding utility nodes. The added utility nodes will have the same shape and will have the same amount of attached block storage as other utility nodes in the cluster.

info.name: Add Worker Nodes to a Cluster

params.name: bdsInstanceId
params.description: The OCID of the cluster.

items.docs: Increases the size (scales out) of a cluster by adding worker nodes (data/compute/edge). The added worker and compute only worker nodes will have the same amount of attached block storage as other nodes of the same type in the cluster. Edge nodes can have different block storage sizes within the valid range (50GB-10TB).

info.name: Resize a Cluster by Changing Node Shapes

params.name: bdsInstanceId
params.description: The OCID of the cluster.

items.docs: Changes the size of a cluster by scaling up or scaling down the nodes. Nodes are scaled up or down by changing the shapes of all the nodes of the same type to the next larger or smaller shape. The node types are master, utility, worker, and Cloud SQL. Only nodes with VM-STANDARD shapes can be scaled.
